rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, That's really generous, thank you. We're still scoping the first concrete project (likely something evals-shaped — building and testing a measurement of some AI-safety-relevant gap that isn't well covered yet), so I don't want to hand you a half-formed task. I'll follow up in the next week or two with something specific once that's nailed down — your data-analyst background will probably be exactly what's useful once we're scoring/analyzing results rather than just planning. In the meantime, if you've got a view on what's most neglected out there, I'd genuinely like to hear it. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (offered to help) with a friendly holding note — low-stakes, no commitments made.
